title: Create a draft order
objective: Confirm that an authorized customer can create an order with a visible reference in DRAFT state.
preconditions: A synthetic customer is signed in.

test_data.name: order
test_data.description: Synthetic order data accepted by the available order entry point.

steps.action: Submit a create-order request using the synthetic order data.
steps.expected_result: An order is created and a visible order reference is provided.

steps.action: Observe the state shown for the created order.

postconditions: A synthetic order exists in DRAFT state.
cleanup: Remove the synthetic order using an approved test-environment procedure.
